# LabLayout

> Offline, single-file room builder for labs, shops and tool cribs. You sketch the room, place benches, cabinets and machines, then export a self-contained HTML inventory tracker.

AI agents can generate layouts as JSON specs:

- Spec format, rules and library kinds: [docs/AI_LAYOUT_GUIDE.md](docs/AI_LAYOUT_GUIDE.md)
- Load a spec: open `dist/builder.html#layout=<base64url JSON>`, or call `window.LabLayout.importSpec(spec)` on the builder page
- Check before loading: `window.LabLayout.validate(spec)`; read the current room: `window.LabLayout.exportSpec()`
- Units: feet for the room and positions, inches for furniture fronts and cells; origin at the top-left

## Files

- [dist/builder.html](dist/builder.html): the ready-to-open builder
- [README.md](README.md): features and setup
